stories.name: ExxonMobil stock valuation
stories.blurb: Investors and analysts are debating whether ExxonMobil shares are undervalued or overvalued after strong earnings, a big price run, and a dividend increase.

stories.name: Big Oil War Windfall
stories.blurb: ExxonMobil and other oil giants are facing political backlash over massive profits earned from the Iran conflict while Americans pay high gas prices.

stories.blurb: A series of headlines analyzing Chevron's earnings, stock performance, and growth prospects as investors assess whether the energy major can keep rallying.

past.name: Daily sector performance
past.blurb: A recurring daily market report tracking how many of the 11 S&P sectors rise or fall and which sector groups (cyclicals, defensives, growth) lead or trail, with ExxonMobil cited as a notable mover.

6.text: ExxonMobil beat Q3 2026 estimates with $113.2B revenue and $4.23 non-GAAP EPS, raised its dividend, and hit a new 52-week high, though shares later slipped. Analysts raised targets (UBS to $213) citing refining strength and LNG expansion, but remain divided on valuation.

5.text: Trump alternated threats and claims of Iranian peace talks while the U.S. bombed Iran before Election Day; oil fell about 1% to $96 as traders bet on de-escalation. Newsom and Sanders accused Trump of handing ExxonMobil, Chevron and Shell war windfalls, while analysts said the conflict boosts the majors' longer-run prospects.

4.text: ExxonMobil signed a 15-year gas sale agreement with STAK Energy to supply a new power plant on Alaska's North Slope. The other articles don't involve ExxonMobil: Kazakhstan's oil exports to Germany won't resume by end-2026, and BP appointed Emma Lewis to lead downstream.

7.text: ExxonMobil beat Q3 2026 consensus estimates on higher crude prices and better operations, with its stock up nearly 50% year to date before retreating from 52-week highs. Other articles focus on Chevron, Suncor, Cheniere, and energy plays, barely bearing on ExxonMobil.
